hero.title: A simple tool to plan and track your budget
hero.text: Add your income, plan your expenses and record your spending day to day. See your monthly situation without unnecessary complexity.

planning.title: Monthly planning
planning.description: Set your planned income and expenses for a clear view from the start of the month.

tracking.title: Daily tracking
tracking.description: Record your expenses easily from your phone or computer.

summary.title: Clear summary
summary.description: Compare planned and actual amounts and see your results without a complex table.

about.title: A simple, personal approach
about.text: Budget Planner is not meant to replace a financial advisor. It is a personal tool designed to keep a clear view of your finances and track your spending habits without making things complicated.
